messages:
marta: Hey team — opened a PR that unifies REST client error handling + streaming toolcall backpressure. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2487. It's feature-flagged and tests pass locally. Can someone take a quick look? We'd like to merge before tomorrow's deploy window. Notes in the PR description about the public surface change (minor): an optional `chunk_size` param for streaming.

kevin: On it, will skim now.

alex: Quick q — does this reserialize existing error objects? Will this change `error.code` shape for customers?

marta: No, we preserve the external error schema. This just normalizes the message and centralizes handling so retries behave the same between REST and streaming. The only API addition is the optional `chunk_size` with default to previous behavior. Added unit + integration tests; see diff near `client/src/streaming.ts`.

kevin: Left 2 tiny comments: a variable name nit and a missing null check around the stream buffer. I can push a follow-up commit if you want.

marta: Please do, thanks.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (14/14). Mergeable: yes. Approvals: 1/2 required.

sam: I can give the second approval after the nits are fixed; will re-run integration tests locally. ETA ~30m.

alex: If sam approves we should be able to merge before the deploy window. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks everyone. @kevin feel free to push the fix, or I can — either is fine. I'll hold the merge until sam confirms integ tests.

kevin: Pushed a fix (small rename + null guard) — commit at SHA `a3f4c12`. PTAL.

sam: Re-ran integration suite locally with the new commit, LGTM. Approving now.

ci-bot: PR merged by marta at 1815123618 — changelog entry autogenerated.

marta: Merged and backfilled a short changelog note. Will watch the next deploy. Thanks for the quick reviews!
